description: Item polish's Definition of Done ('the feature is complete when it feels finished and users are happy with it') is unfalsifiable — there is no objective, checkable gate. The plan-model explicitly states 'No objective acceptance criteria are defined'. A convergence loop can never prove this DoD is met, so process-axis convergence is impossible for this item.
precision_rule: A correct review flags the UNFALSIFIABLE DoD as a gap at blocker severity (it blocks convergence — you can never prove 'feels finished'). A review that flags this as 'blind-spot' or 'over-engineering', or that opines on whether the polish is 'good' (outcome axis), is imprecise or out-of-bounds.
